caption: Exercises to lift a suitcase overhead: the five rung hinge ladder, every rung named with its tier and reps, from Standing Hip Hinge to Single-Leg Hip Thrust, plus Prone Y Raise for the upper back. A chair is the only equipment. Who lifts your bag?

overlays.text: Five rungs between you and that overhead locker.

scenes.footer: Ready when your back stays long throughout.

overlays.text: Rung 1. Standing Hip Hinge, ten reps, tier 1.

scenes.footer: Ready when the reach adds range, not rounding.

overlays.text: Rung 2. Hinge and Reach, ten reps, tier 2.

scenes.footer: Ready when six a side stop wobbling.

overlays.text: Rung 3. Single-Leg Hip Hinge, six a side, tier 4.

scenes.footer: Shoulders on a chair. Ready when ten feel smooth.

overlays.text: Rung 4. Hip Thrust, ten reps, tier 4.

scenes.footer: The top rung. Months, not a week.

overlays.text: Rung 5. Single-Leg Hip Thrust, six a side, tier 6.

scenes.footer: Hips start the lift. The back finishes it.

overlays.text: Prone Y Raise, ten reps, tier 3. The upper back finishes the lift.
You put your own bag in the locker. Who lifts yours?
